description: Precision at range - the shot placed exactly where it matters.

nodes.name: Improved Concussive Shot
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your Concussive Shot by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the duration of your Concussive Shot's daze effect by 1/2 sec.' Built as duration. Daze itself has no engine equivalent, but the ability already exists with its own effect, so extending it is faithful. Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 3 ranks to the real 2.

nodes.name: Focused Aim
nodes.description: Increases your chance to hit by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Steady Shot by 35%/70%, and increases your chance to hit by 1%/2%/3%.' The hit half is verbatim; no cast times means no pushback. Kept from the outgoing tree. hit_rating is PERCENTAGE POINTS and is NOT a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET.

nodes.name: Lethal Shots
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Requires Bows, Crossbows, Guns, Thrown. Increases your critical strike chance with ranged weapons by 1%-5%.' Built minus the weapon gate - there is no weapon-type key. The outgoing version granted per-ability crit on two shots, which is Improved Barrage's shape.

nodes.name: Careful Aim
nodes.description: Increases your ranged attack power by 33% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases your ranged attack power by an amount equal to 33%-100% of your total Intellect.' A REAL stat conversion and this tree's best talent - ranged_ap is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and intellect a valid source. MEASURED LIVE at +29 ranged attack power off 29 Intellect, so the key is a RAW MULTIPLIER and not a percentage; authoring 100 would have granted a hundred times the hunter's Intellect. The outgoing node was a proc with an empty effects dict.

nodes.name: Go for the Throat
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase your pet's damage for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Your ranged critical hits cause your pet to generate 25/50 Focus.' DEPARTURE - pets have NO RESOURCE in this engine, so there is no Focus to generate, and a talent effect cannot reach the pet in any case. The buff lands on the hunter. NOTE the stat_mod is damage_dealt_pct in PERCENTAGE POINTS: all_damage would be SILENT DEAD DATA inside a status effect, read through the talent channel while status stat_mods go to get_status_stat_mod. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Improved Hunter's Mark
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Hunter's Mark by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the bonus attack power granted by your Hunter's Mark ability by 10%/20%/30%, and reduces the mana cost.' Built as potency, which scales the ability's own stat_mods. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used _duration.

nodes.name: Improved Arcane Shot
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Arcane Shot by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the damage done by your Arcane Shot by 5%/10%/15%.' Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 7% to the real 5% per rank.

nodes.name: Mortal Shots
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your abilities by 6% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your ranged abilities by 6%-30%.' crit_damage_physical is a FRACTION, read at abilities.py:1460 inside a ternary - live despite the probe finding no literal read site, and DEAD inside a status effect, so the talent-effect form used here is the only one that works. The outgoing version was per-ability DAMAGE on Aimed Shot, which is a different stat. It is Aimed Shot's prerequisite in the real tree.

nodes.name: Concussive Barrage
nodes.description: Your Multi-Shot and Chimera Shot have a 50% chance per rank to slow the target for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your successful Chimera Shot and Multi-Shot attacks have a 50%/100% chance to Daze the target for 4 sec.' Built with the real ability pair and the real chance curve. Daze has no engine equivalent, so it is a haste debuff on the target - which is what a dazed enemy amounts to here. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Improved Stings
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Serpent Sting and Wyvern Sting by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim across both real Stings: 'Increases the damage done by your Serpent Sting and Wyvern Sting by 10%/20%/30%.' Kept from the outgoing tree, corrected from 5 ranks to the real 3.

nodes.name: Readiness
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Aimed Shot and Multi-Shot by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'When activated, this ability immediately finishes the cooldown on your other Hunter abilities.' DEPARTURE - there is no hunter_readiness ability to unlock. Delivered as a standing cooldown reduction on the tree's two cooldown shots. Kept from the outgoing tree. It is Trueshot Aura's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Efficiency
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your shots and stings by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim across all four shots and Serpent Sting: 'Reduces the Mana cost of your Shots and Stings by 3%-15%.' Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key on two of them.

nodes.name: Barrage
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the damage done by your Multi-Shot, Aimed Shot, and Volley spells by 4%/8%/12%.' Volley does not exist. Kept from the outgoing tree, which covered Multi-Shot alone. It is Improved Barrage's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Combat Experience
nodes.description: Increases your Agility and Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases your total Agility and Intellect by 2%/4%.' Both are PERCENTAGE POINTS, read off `bonuses` and divided by 100. The Intellect half feeds Careful Aim two tiers up, which is the real pairing. The outgoing version granted FLAT agility and intellect.

nodes.name: Ranged Weapon Specialization
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Requires Ranged Weapon. Increases the damage you deal with ranged weapons by 2%/4%/5%.' Built minus the weapon gate. Note requires_ranged_weapon IS a real ABILITY field in this engine, but there is no talent-side equivalent. physical_damage is a FRACTION. The outgoing version was per-ability damage at 5 ranks.

nodes.name: Piercing Shots
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 33% chance per rank to leave the target bleeding for 3 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Your critical Aimed, Steady and Chimera Shots cause the target to bleed for 10%/20%/30% of the damage dealt over 8 sec.' Built as a real bleed on the real trigger. Percentage-of-damage is not available to a dot payload - potency is a FLAT PER-TURN number, where an ABILITY rank's effect_value is the TOTAL and gets divided - so 45 a turn over 3 turns (8 seconds) stands in. The ability_filter is omitted because on_crit already requires a crit and restricting it would exclude the auto-shot crits this tree is built to produce. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Trueshot Aura
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 10%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Increases the attack power of party and raid members within 100 yards by 10%.' DEPARTURE - A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY. The real 10% applies to the hunter alone. The real talent requires Readiness, which connected_to reproduces. attack_power_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS. The outgoing version granted FLAT attack_power.

nodes.name: Master Marksman
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank and reduces the cost of your shots by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built with both halves: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 1%-5%, and reduces the Mana cost of your Steady Shot, Aimed Shot and Arcane Shot by 2%-10%.' Stacks with Efficiency and Lethal Shots, as the real tree intends. The outgoing version was per-ability damage.

nodes.name: Improved Barrage
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Multi-Shot and Aimed Shot abilities by 4%/8%/12%.' The real talent requires Barrage, which connected_to reproduces. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Wild Quiver
nodes.description: Your shots have a 4% chance per rank to loose an additional arrow.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'You have a 4%/8%/12% chance to shoot an additional shot when doing damage, dealing 80% weapon damage.' Built with the real chance curve. Weapon-damage scaling is not available to a proc payload, so damage_flat 85 stands in. proc['school'] only TYPES a damage_flat payload; it is not a trigger-side filter. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Marked for Death
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your shots by 1% per rank and your pet's damage by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built verbatim with both halves: 'Increases your damage done by your shots and the damage done by your pet's special abilities by 1%-5%.' pet_damage is a FRACTION read at pet.py:139 - one of only three pet keys that work. NOTE this talent also appears as Beast Mastery's capstone, where it takes the slot the unbuildable Beast Mastery talent would have had; the duplication is deliberate and recorded in both builders.

nodes.name: Improved Steady Shot
nodes.description: Your Steady Shot has a 5% chance per rank to make your next shots hit 15% harder.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, NEW to our tree: 'Your Steady Shot hits have a 5%/10%/15% chance to increase the damage done by your next Aimed Shot, Arcane Shot or Chimera Shot by 15%.' Built with the real chance curve, the real ability_filter on Steady Shot, and the real 15%. Scoping the BUFF to three specific abilities is not possible - a status effect's stat_mods apply to everything - so it lifts all damage for 2 turns instead.

nodes.name: Chimera Shot
nodes.description: Teaches Chimera Shot, a shot that refreshes your Sting as it strikes.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for hunter_chimera_shot, which is requires_talent.
